title: Joomla article image alt and captions change as copy while native structure remains enforced
steps: Fill empty Joomla intro/fulltext image alt and captions, then edit those descriptions again.
Change alignment, remove a metadata field, change alt to a boolean or add an arbitrary layout key.
expect: Only image description value changes pass native structure.
Alignment, missing or added fields and non-string types still fail.
evidence: Official Joomla Retry check2 rejected article/1–10 image_intro_alt strings as native-structure differences; meaningful image descriptions are allowed content.
fence: Only four exact Joomla image text field names are normalized, and only for string values; keys, types, alignment and every other structural invariant remain.

tests: Joomla article image alt and caption are copy; alignment, keys and types remain structure
